human_decisions_in_scope: RA17-Q-01: 365-day no-related-ticket retention begins at Customer.CreatedAt; a newly associated ticket suspends pending cleanup/reset eligibility; after all related tickets are Closed or Cancelled, restart from the latest terminal-transition timestamp; never purge with active related tickets; revalidate relationships and eligibility before deletion.

RA17-Q-02: Support Agent Customer access only through a ticket currently assigned to that Agent; no exception or separate grant; revoke on reassignment, loss of team/tenant authorization, or scope loss; server-side on every request including direct-ID lookup; no tenant-wide browsing or access via other Agents' tickets; preserve four roles/default-deny.

RA17-Q-03: Tenant Admin owns central triage for completely unassigned tickets only within own tenant; no new role or separate permission; Managers may access/route assigned-team tickets including without Agent assignment, but not globally unassigned or other-team tickets; Agents remain scoped; Platform Admin has no routine tenant ticket-business access; enforce server-side and audit.

RA17-Q-04: Following 30-day grace and independent second Platform Admin approval, permanent tenant deletion overrides 365-day retention for deactivated-user records in that tenant; purge eligible personal and business records; preserve only minimum necessary protected security/admin audit metadata, including original or irreversible pseudonymous actor ID and applicable action/approval/tenant/resource/permission/timestamp/outcome/correlation details; exclude passwords, tokens, personal email, unnecessary personal data, and deleted business/customer content; do not restore deleted business records; retain existing independent audit policy/access controls.

Customer Search (mandatory first release): server-side Customer ID exact, Display Name partial case-insensitive, Company/Organization partial case-insensitive search; status and created-date-range filters; display-name ascending/descending and created-date newest/oldest sorting; validated configurable maximum page size, filters before pagination, total count and metadata; email not searchable; role scopes as specified by the user; enforce for search and direct IDs.

Feedback Read (mandatory first release): explicit permission in centralized versioned default-deny catalogue; Tenant Admin own-tenant feedback, Manager assigned-team feedback, Agent own submissions only, Platform Admin no routine individual feedback/comments except already-permitted aggregate analytics; fields limited to feedback ID, rating, optional reason, submitting user ID/time, associated conversation/message ID, tenant ID; no conversation history/message access; server-side enforcement and audit with sensitive-data minimization.

Customer email unmasking (mandatory first release): Platform Admin, Support Manager, Support Agent receive masked email; Tenant Admin may see full registered address only for own-tenant customers through explicitly authorized customer-detail operation; all API/search/AI tool/lookup paths enforce masking; audit every full-email access with actor, tenant, customer ID, timestamp, action, outcome, correlation ID; avoid unnecessary full-email exposure in logs, prompts, indexes, or unauthorized responses.
